_comment: Plain-engineering explanations for domain terms. Used only when you ask the rewriting assistant to translate a statement, and only adopted after your approval. Explanations must describe the term generally — never add facts about your own work. Add or override entries in Settings.

terms.radiosonde: radiosonde (balloon-borne atmospheric sensor and telemetry package)
terms.radiosondes: radiosondes (balloon-borne atmospheric sensor and telemetry packages)
terms.ground receiving system: ground receiving system (telemetry receiver and decoder)
terms.automatic weather station: automatic weather station (networked environmental sensor node)
terms.doppler weather radar: Doppler weather radar (pulse-Doppler radar for precipitation and wind measurement)
terms.wind profiler: wind profiler (radar for vertical wind measurement)
terms.hydrogen generator: hydrogen generator (gas generation plant for balloon inflation)
terms.dropsonde: dropsonde (air-launched atmospheric sensor and telemetry package)
